title: leprechan salt and pepper set
text: leprechan salt and pepper set. I actually purchased this for a seasonal note under my LED stick tree that I change with the seasons.  It works perfectly.  I turned it around so that you don't see the print and it is perfect with the shamrocks hanging from the tree.  As I am not actually using it as a salt and pepper, I expect will last a long time.  But I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  The set is ceramic.  The colors are vibrant. And they "stick" together with a magnet.  They stand about 3 1/2" tall.  Small, but cute.
